_comment: The fleet's optional skill groups. A group is a set of fleet skills an install takes as one unit,
and the conventions values those skills fill. JSON has no comments, so every key starting with _ is
Each group, under its name: skills, the fleet skills it adds to the install manifest's `skills`
(each a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md in this tree); conventions, the conventions keys
(CONVENTIONS.md) its skills fill, each value in the manifest's {"skill": "<name>"} form, naming
Taking a group is a manifest edit and nothing else: add every name in its `skills` to the
manifest's `skills`, and set the conventions keys it fills to its values, or to the install's own
skill or document where the install keeps one (a key the group fills is still the install's to
set). A manifest that takes no group is exactly what templates/fleet.example.json writes.
The install-agent-fleet skill offers each group as one item; its Upgrade section says how an
existing install takes one later. This file is the one list of a group's skills: the installer,
the skill-references gate and the manifest tests read it, and README.md's bullet for the group
How agents develop, land and release software: practice (software-development) and the
process skills that fill the definition_of_done, branch_naming, workspace, release and
environments keys. For an install whose agents change a code repository. A group skill cites a
sibling by name; fleet prose outside the group cites the conventions key instead.
